1.w: A gentle response turns away anger, but a harsh word stirs up wrath.

2.w: The tongue of the wise treats knowledge correctly, but the mouth of the fool spouts out folly.

3.w: The eyes of the Lord are in every place, keeping watch on those who are evil and those who are good.

4.w: Speech that heals is like a life-giving tree, but a perverse speech breaks the spirit.

5.w: A fool rejects his father’s discipline, but whoever heeds reproof shows good sense.

6.w: In the house of the righteous is abundant wealth, but the income of the wicked will be ruined.

7.w: The lips of the wise spread knowledge, but not so the heart of fools.

8.w: The Lord abhors the sacrifice of the wicked, but the prayer of the upright pleases him.

9.w: The Lord abhors the way of the wicked, but he will love those who pursue righteousness.

10.w: Severe discipline is for the one who abandons the way; the one who hates reproof will die.

11.w: Death and Destruction are before the Lord — how much more the hearts of humans!

12.w: The scorner will not love one who corrects him; he will not go to the wise.

13.w: A joyful heart makes the face cheerful, but by a painful heart the spirit is broken.

14.w: The discerning mind seeks knowledge, but the mouth of fools feeds on folly.

15.w: All the days of the afflicted are bad, but one with a cheerful heart has a continual feast.

16.w: Better is little with the fear of the Lord than great wealth and turmoil with it.

17.w: Better a meal of vegetables where there is love than a fattened ox where there is hatred.

18.w: A quick-tempered person stirs up dissension, but one who is slow to anger calms a quarrel.

19.w: The way of the sluggard is like a hedge of thorns, but the path of the upright is like a highway.

20.w: A wise child brings joy to his father, but a foolish person despises his mother.

21.w: Folly is a joy to one who lacks sense, but one who has understanding follows an upright course.

22.w: Plans fail when there is no counsel, but with abundant advisers they are established.

23.w: A person has joy in giving an appropriate answer, and a word at the right time —how good it is!

24.w: The path of life is upward for the wise person, to keep him from going downward to Sheol.

25.w: The Lord tears down the house of the proud, but he maintains the boundaries of the widow.

26.w: The Lord abhors the plans of the wicked, but pleasant words are pure.

27.w: The one who is greedy for gain troubles his household, but whoever hates bribes will live.

28.w: The heart of the righteous considers how to answer, but the mouth of the wicked pours out evil things.

29.w: The Lord is far from the wicked, but he hears the prayer of the righteous.

30.w: A bright look brings joy to the heart, and good news gives health to the body.

31.w: The person who hears the reproof that leads to life is at home among the wise.

32.w: The one who refuses correction despises himself, but whoever listens to reproof acquires understanding.

33.w: The fear of the Lord provides wise instruction, and before honor comes humility.
